nodes.statement: Alderstone generated FY2025 reported revenue of $74.0m.
Alderstone reported EBITDA for FY2025 was $10.2m from historical accounts.
Based on procedures performed and adjustments documented, normalized FY2025 EBITDA is $11.9m.
Founder and executive compensation of $0.35m was accepted at market replacement cost.
Transaction-readiness and professional-fee adjustment of $0.25m excludes recurring audit and compliance support.

nodes.label: EBITDA Adjustment - Transaction-Readiness and Professional Fees

nodes.statement: Integration and systems costs of $0.30m were accepted only for identifiable non-recurring items; $0.10m recurring cost retained by firm.

nodes.label: EBITDA Adjustment - Integration and Systems Costs
Alderstone normalized EBITDA add-back, non-recurring only

nodes.statement: Legal and settlement expense of $0.20m was supported as a non-recurring item.

nodes.label: EBITDA Adjustment - Legal and Settlement Expense

nodes.statement: Duplicate occupancy and facility move costs of $0.15m represent an implemented closure.

nodes.label: EBITDA Adjustment - Duplicate Occupancy and Facility Move

nodes.statement: Implemented headcount savings of $0.25m are additional covenant-certified savings.
Pricing and utilization initiatives were not accepted as historical earnings adjustments because they represent forecast only.

nodes.label: EBITDA Adjustment - Pricing and Utilization Initiatives

nodes.statement: Revenue cut-off correction of $0.10m negative adjustment reduced normalized EBITDA due to QoE finding.
Bonus accrual normalization of $0.20m was supported by the approved plan and subsequent reversal.
Related-party rent of $0.10m was normalized to market terms and not recognized in covenant definition.
The seller proposed a normalized operating working capital target of $7.7m.

nodes.label: Alderstone operating working capital, seller proposal

nodes.statement: QoE-normalized operating working capital is $8.4m, exceeding the seller-proposed target of $7.7m.
The working capital difference of $0.7m reflects seasonal payroll accruals, aged unbilled WIP, acquired-branch billing delays, deferred-revenue normalization and month-end timing.
nodes.derivation: WC difference = $8.4m normalized − $7.7m seller target = $0.7m variance
